headline: ReNew Q2 Revenue Up 28% as Company Raises Manufacturing Guidance
summary: ReNew reported a 28 percent increase in second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue and raised its guidance based on manufacturing expansion.
why: Renewable energy providers' revenue growth and guidance upgrades reflect broader corporate clean-energy transition adoption and manufacturing scaling.

impacts.name: ReNew Energy Global
impacts.why: Strong revenue growth and raised guidance signal robust operational expansion.
